title: Munich — Fröttmaninger Berg & Isar Gravel
short_pitch: North-Munich classic: firm Isar gravel, open heath, and a 360° city–Alps view from an artificial hill next to the Allianz Arena.

pois.name: St. Emmeram Bridge
pois.why_good: Iconic wooden Isar crossing that drops you straight onto the floodplain gravel paths.

pois.name: Südliche Fröttmaninger Heide
pois.why_good: Wide heath reserve with rare flora and open sightlines toward the Allianz Arena.

pois.name: Fröttmaninger Berg
pois.why_good: Former landfill hill with wind turbine and clear-day Alps panorama over Munich.

pois.name: Allianz Arena
pois.why_good: Herzog & de Meuron’s glowing stadium is the landmark you circle on the gravel fringe.

pois.name: Heilig-Kreuz-Kirche Fröttmaning
pois.why_good: Munich’s oldest surviving church building, last remnant of the abandoned village.

title: Berlin — Tempelhofer Feld & Landwehrkanal

start_area.city_region: Berlin Kreuzberg / Platz der Luftbrücke, Germany

short_pitch: Car-free airport runways plus canal towpaths — the definitive Berlin after-work loop with skyline wind and Kreuzberg energy.

pois.name: Tempelhofer Feld (runway loop)
pois.why_good: Former Tempelhof Airport’s vast asphalt/gravel runways, Berlin’s favorite flat spin with skyline views.

pois.name: Columbia Damm entrance
pois.why_good: Main Neukölln/Kreuzberg gateway into the Feld with bike-friendly access.

pois.name: Allmende-Kontor
pois.why_good: Community gardens on the Feld that show Berlin’s DIY urban culture up close.

pois.name: Maybachufer / Landwehrkanal
pois.why_good: Canal bank famous for the Turkish market and easy café stops between Kreuzberg and Neukölln.

pois.name: Platz der Luftbrücke
pois.why_good: Airlift memorial and U-Bahn hub anchoring the historic airport approach.

title: Vienna — Prater Hauptallee & Donauinsel Süd
short_pitch: Dead-flat imperial avenue into the Green Prater, then Danube Island tip for a swim stop — perfect e-bike friendly Wien Rundkurs.

pois.name: Prater Hauptallee
pois.why_good: Multi-kilometre car-free axis through the Green Prater, opened to the public by Joseph II.

pois.name: Schweizerhaus
pois.why_good: Classic Prater beer garden famous for Stelzen and Erdäpfelpuffer under the chestnut trees.

pois.name: Lusthaus
pois.why_good: Former imperial hunting pavilion at the end of Hauptallee, now a café-restaurant landmark.

pois.name: Wallfahrtskirche Maria Grün
pois.why_good: Yellow pilgrimage chapel tucked in the Prater woods, a quiet detour off Aspernallee.

pois.name: Donauinsel Südspitze
pois.why_good: Southern tip of Danube Island with Neue Donau swim spots and big-sky river views.

title: Innsbruck — Hungerburg–Arzler Alm Trail
short_pitch: City-to-alm MTB in under 75 minutes: forest-road climb, Tyrolean hut stop, then legal flow singletrack back toward Mühlau.

pois.name: Hungerburgbahn / Hungerburg
pois.why_good: Funicular top station and natural MTB staging area above Innsbruck.

pois.name: Arzler Alm
pois.why_good: Hut at ~1,067 m with terrace views over the Inn Valley and legendary dumpling stops.

pois.name: Arzler Alm Trail entrance
pois.why_good: Marked legal singletrack start ~300 m east of the Alm toward Mühlauer Quelle.

pois.name: Hungerburg Trail
pois.why_good: Short flow downhill near Hungerburg with optional doubles and Inn Valley vistas.

pois.name: Nordkettenbahn Hungerburg
pois.why_good: Cable-car hub linking city riders to higher Nordkette options after the loop.

title: Cologne — Kölner Rhein-Runde
short_pitch: Official ~21 km Rhine loop: Dom skyline, Rheinboulevard photo stop, Poller Wiesen picnic lawns, and Kölsch pauses on both banks.

pois.name: Kölner Dom
pois.why_good: Gothic cathedral start/finish and the city’s unmistakable skyline anchor.

pois.name: Rheinboulevard (Deutz)
pois.why_good: Stepped riverside plaza with the classic Dom + Hohenzollernbrücke postcard view.

pois.name: Rheinpark
pois.why_good: Broad parkland on the right bank with café stops and event lawns between Mülheim and Deutz.

pois.name: Poller Wiesen
pois.why_good: Riverside meadows facing the Rheinauhafen Kranhäuser — prime picnic and sunset spot.

pois.name: Rheinauhafen Kranhäuser
pois.why_good: Crane-house trio marking Cologne’s modern harbour skyline on the return bank.

pois.name: Schokoladenmuseum
pois.why_good: Family-friendly museum stop at the north end of Rheinauhafen before the Dom finish.

title: Zurich — Seefeld & Zürichhorn Lakeside
short_pitch: Smooth lakeside promenade roads from Bellevue to Zürichhorn and back via Seefeld — Alps-on-the-water views in a tidy hour.

pois.name: Bürkliplatz
pois.why_good: Central lake plaza and bike-lane junction where Limmat meets Zürichsee.

pois.name: Opernhaus Zürich / Sechseläutenplatz
pois.why_good: Landmark square on the east-shore start of the Utoquai ride.

pois.name: Zürichhorn
pois.why_good: Park peninsula with open lake lawns and clear views toward the Alps and Uetliberg.

pois.name: Chinagarten Zürich
pois.why_good: Gift garden from Kunming beside Zürichhorn; seasonal opening, tram stop Chinagarten.

pois.name: Pavillon Le Corbusier
pois.why_good: Compact modernist pavilion next to the Chinese Garden on the Seefeld shore.

title: Lake Constance — Konstanz Staad–Mainau Shore
short_pitch: Bodensee classic: Altstadt to Staad ferry harbour, flower-island approaches, and lakeshore gravel/asphalt perfect for e-bikes.

pois.name: Fähre Konstanz–Meersburg (Staad)
pois.why_good: Year-round car ferry (~15 min crossing); bikes ride free on weekends and holidays.

pois.name: Insel Mainau (gate / causeway)
pois.why_good: Famous Blumeninsel; bikes park at the entrance — walk-on visit optional.

pois.name: Ruppaner Brauerei
pois.why_good: Lakeside Konstanz brewery on the Bodensee-Radweg between Staad and Egg.

pois.name: Hörnle / Strandbad area
pois.why_good: Popular Konstanz swim and lakeshore hangout near the ferry approaches.

pois.name: Alte Rheinbrücke Konstanz
pois.why_good: Historic Rhine bridge linking Altstadt to the Mainaustraße bike corridor.
